checks.description: every id-shaped token in every output is a normalized event or a quarantined record of this run, and every timeline entry, hypothesis, alternative, link, edge, detection and incident entity cites at least one
narrative text uses no causal wording except on links whose type is causal
every link has a valid link_type; causal and temporal links join two events; every causal link's shared session, request or process id or recorded parent id is recomputed from the two cited events
every attribution edge cites one event that itself names the entity it points at (actor, target or address), or for audit edges names both the actor and the target
temporal links say followed, preceded, within, after or before, and nothing causal
every event (and every duplicate delivery) re-derives its event id from the raw input record it cites; every quarantined record points at a real input record
received = accepted + duplicates + quarantined for every batch and source, and the totals match the events and quarantine files
hypotheses that depend on an evidence gap name it, list it as missing evidence and drop one confidence level (unless already low)
metrics, summary and report state that data and labels are synthetic and the numbers do not estimate real-world performance
sha256 of every other evidence file is recorded here and re-verified by validate()
